description_en: Queries the remediations in a specified account group
description_zh: 查询指定账号组下所有修正列表
kebab_example: aliyun config list-aggregate-remediations --config-rule-ids cr-6b7c626622af00b40000 --aggregator-id ca-6b4a626622af00120000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAggregateRemediations

parameters.description_en:
The rule IDs. Separate multiple rule IDs with commas (,).

For more information about how to obtain a rule ID, see [ListAggregateConfigRules](~~264148~~).
